Container.Name: vectorcraft
Container.Overview: VectorCraft is an open-source, clean-room reimplementation of Adobe Illustrator in Rust, from the ArtCraft Crafting Apps. Fast, open-source vector illustration, reimagined in pure Rust. This container serves its browser (WebAssembly) build with nginx. All work happens in your browser: Open/Save use the browser file picker and downloads, so nothing is stored on the server and no volume is needed. WebGPU and clipboard APIs require a secure context, so reach it over HTTPS (for example via Unraid's Tailscale integration with Tailscale Serve, or a reverse proxy) or via localhost. Early alpha software.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the web UI (container port 8080). Unique per app, see PORTS.md.

Config.Name: Appdata (Tailscale state only)
Config.Description: Not used by the app (documents stay in your browser). Only gives the Unraid Tailscale hook a persistent folder for its state; safe to ignore if you do not use Tailscale.
